name: Luminal Neo-Noir Movie
description: A cinematic LoRA infused with Eastern urban noir. Fog and neon bleed into each other, painting dim alleys and late-night diners in glowing reds, greens, and cold blues. Stylized lighting with dreamlike contrasts, evoking lost reels from a surreal neo-noir film. It blends mystery, melancholy, and the unmistakable pulse of East Asian cityscapes.
